currentContext.expansion: The Company states it has no expansion or modernization programme at present, attributing this to unfavourable market conditions. Rather than adding capacity, installed spinning capacity was reduced during the year from 55,296 spindles to 49,536 spindles as at March 31, 2026 following the sale of some obsolete machineries. The only investment narrative in the bundle is maintenance-type and efficiency-type spending: the Company says it continues to invest in modernization, energy-efficient technologies and process improvements to enhance productivity and reduce operating costs, and it implemented energy conservation measures including replacement of conventional lighting with energy-efficient lighting, installation of energy-efficient equipment and continuous monitoring of energy consumption. Its existing 2.72 MW ground-mounted/rooftop solar power plant continued to run and generated approximately 30.37 lakh kWh during FY2025-26; management says it will continue to focus on technological upgradation and sustainable manufacturing practices. Existing water infrastructure (rainwater harvesting, groundwater recharge, ETP, MEE and STP) also continued in operation. No new project, site, commissioning date or ramp-up timeline is disclosed anywhere in this bundle, and the Company reports no subsidiary, joint venture or associate company.
